passage.text: Please always use a towel on the equipment.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz ˈɔːlweɪz ˈjuːz ə ˈtaʊəl ɑːn ði ɪˈkwɪpmənt.

passage.text: Keep your bag in a locker, and don't forget your key.
passage.reading: ˈkiːp jʊr ˈbæɡ ɪn ə ˈlɑːkər, ənd ˈdoʊnt fərˈɡɛt jʊr ˈkiː.

passage.text: Clean the equipment after you use it.
passage.reading: ˈkliːn ði ɪˈkwɪpmənt ˈæftər juː ˈjuːz ɪt.

passage.text: You can drink water, but please don't eat in the gym.
passage.reading: juː kən ˈdrɪŋk ˈwɔːtər, bʌt ˈpliːz ˈdoʊnt ˈiːt ɪn ðə ˈdʒɪm.

passage.text: We have new class times this semester.
passage.reading: wiː ˈhæv ˈnuː ˈklæs ˌtaɪmz ðɪs səˈmɛstər.

passage.text: Yoga classes are on Monday and Wednesday from 6 to 7 p.m.
passage.reading: ˈjoʊɡə ˌklæsɪz ər ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ ənd ˈwɛnzdeɪ frəm ˈsɪks tə ˈsɛvən ˌpiːˈɛm.

passage.text: Badminton classes are on Tuesday and Thursday from 5 to 6 p.m.
passage.reading: ˈbædmɪntən ˌklæsɪz ər ɑːn ˈtuːzdeɪ ənd ˈθɜːrzdeɪ frəm ˈfaɪv tə ˈsɪks ˌpiːˈɛm.

passage.text: All classes are free for students.
passage.reading: ˈɔːl ˈklæsɪz ər ˈfriː fər ˈstuːdənts.
